What We Offer
Our Services
01
Exposed Aggregate
Decorative surfaces for driveways, paths, and outdoor areas. A durable, slip-resistant finish with genuine kerb appeal — available in a full range of stone blends and colours.
02
Pool Surrounds
Seamless, watertight pool surrounds engineered for safety and aesthetics. Polished, honed, or exposed finishes precisely detailed to complement any pool design.
03
Floating Stairs & Benches
Cantilevered concrete stairs and feature benches crafted with architectural precision. Structural integrity meets refined design for genuinely unforgettable outdoor spaces.
04
Driveways
From brushed and charcoal-coloured to fully exposed aggregate — residential and commercial driveways built to handle heavy use while holding their finish for decades.
05
Shed Slabs & Footings
Reinforced slabs and footings for sheds, garages, and commercial buildings. Accurately formed, poured, and finished to specification — the solid foundation every project demands.
06
Excavations
Full excavation services including site preparation, cut-and-fill, trenching and soil removal. We handle the groundwork so every great concrete project starts right.

Why Fullcon
Built on
Reputation

Fullcon has been delivering premium concrete and excavation work across Melbourne for over a decade. We don't cut corners — every job is finished the way we'd finish our own home.

I
Fully Licensed & Insured
All work is performed by qualified concreters with full public liability coverage on every project.
II
Transparent Pricing
No hidden costs. Detailed quotes delivered upfront so you know exactly what to expect.
III
On-Time Delivery
We show up when we say we will. Your timeline is taken seriously on every job.
IV
Premium Finishes
From charcoal driveways to mirror-polished pool surrounds — quality that stands up and stands out.
